title: Prisme.ai extension managed configuration
description: Enterprise policy pushed via chrome.storage.managed. Any field set here overrides the user's config and locks the extension to the deployment.

agent.title: Agent ID
agent.description: Default agent the side panel connects to.

org.title: Org slug
org.description: Optional org slug for anonymous access scoping.

toolsWorkspace.title: Browser tools workspace
toolsWorkspace.description: Slug of the workspace exposing client-side tools (e.g. slug:browser-mcp). Blank disables page actions.
